closure_definition: A visitor can open the feedback form, submit valid feedback, view an escaped thanks page, and receive readable errors for invalid paths through a real HTTP server.
acceptance_criteria: AC-T1-1: root redirect, form field rendering, blank validation, and access-log observability behave as specified.
AC-LEN-1: negative Content-Length and oversized form bodies are rejected with readable errors before feedback is accepted.
AC-T2-1: valid submission, thanks page rendering, HTML escaping, and missing-id handling behave as specified.
priority_basis: Small form workflow is sufficient to exercise all standard-chain handoffs with direct execution evidence across validation and rendering boundaries.
